verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payments API/platform that itself publishes an MCP server and agent toolkit for other AI agents to consume (visa-intelligent-commerce-docs-8, docs-18, docs-20) — it is the tool-provider, not an agent host into which a user would plug external MCP servers. There is no evidence of an agent runtime within the product that could be configured with third-party MCP servers, making this client-side axis a category error for this product type.
